model: glm-5.3 (in-session LLM labeling via Claude Code CLI; no external API calls)
batch_policy: 8 fixed batches keyed by candidate family (s1-s4 source families, k1-k4 sink families); batch sizes kept stable; every CSV row is dispositioned exactly once (labeled, merged_into, or exact duplicate dropped).

batches.description: HTTP request line / URL path / URL decode source families
HTTP query / header / cookie source families
JSON body / multipart form / multipart generator source families
Direct file-access sink families (open, bos.open, Image.open, ren_open, yieldfile, tx_file/tx_md)
Filesystem operation sink families (stat, checks, unlink, rename, mkdir, sendfile, scandir)
Path propagation / sanitization / VFS resolution families (join, resolve, undot/sanitize_fn, canonical, vfs.get, chk_ap)
Internal wrapper definition rows (functions containing direct fs operations)
